About
IPGMER Kolkata
Institute of Post Graduate Medical Education and Research Kolkata, is a government institution. IPGMER Kolkata offers diploma, UG, PG and doctoral programmes in the field of medicine and allied sciences.
Diploma
courses spanning for two years require students to submit valid scores of qualifying examinations. UG programmes offered include
MBBS
,
B.Sc Nursing Hons
, and
BPT
programmes.
The offered UG programmes span for a duration of four to five years depending on the course students opt for. The MBBS admissions necessitate
NEET
scores to secure a seat. PG admissions are offered for
PGD
and
MD
courses, requiring
NEET PG
scores for a fair evaluation and shortlisting. The doctoral programmes offered include
M.Ch
and
DM
courses spanning a total duration of three years and mandating
NEET SS
scores for admissions.
Institute of Post Graduate Medical Education and Research Kolkata is an affiliated college of
The West Bengal University of Health Sciences, Kolkata
. IPGMER Kolkata is approved by NMC and INC, offering various facilities to students for an all-round development. The facilities include a comprehensive health centre, an extensive library, and modern IT infrastructure. As per the Institute of Post Graduate Medical Education and Research Kolkata placement data for undergraduate programmes, 144 students were placed in the academic year 2023–24, while 120 and 122 students were placed in 2022–23 and 2021–22 respectively.

Admission
Institute of Post Graduate Medical Education and Research Kolkata admission are offered to medical courses such as MBBS, MD, MS, PGD, DM and others. IPGMER Kolkata admission is entrance-based. Candidates are required to take NEET UG, apply for counselling and book their seat for IPGMER MBBS admission. Similarly, for PG courses, NEET PG scores are required.
The superspecialty courses (M.Ch and DM) IPGMER admission required NEET SS scores. Institute of Post Graduate Medical Education and Research admission process involves submitting the application form, required documents, and payment of fees. The admission procedure for
IPGMER
is discussed below.

Candidates must visit the NEET UG/NEET PG and NEET SS registration portal to fill out the application form.
Submit academic details, upload documents as per the specified format and pay the application fee.

IPGMER Kolkata UG Admission Process
After submitting the application form, candidates must apply for NEET UG registration.
Candidates must appear for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) conducted by NTA and obtain a valid score.
After the results, an all-India merit list of the qualified candidates shall be prepared and published based on
NEET
UG scores.
Candidates who meet the IPGMER NEET UG cutoff should apply for the counselling conducted by the West Bengal Medical Counselling Committee. During counselling, Candidates must choose the Institute of Post Graduate Medical Education and Research, Kolkata as their preference.
Once the seats are allotted to the candidates, they must complete the document verification process and pay the fee to confirm admission.

IPGMER PG Admission Process
Candidates must apply for NEET PG registration and take the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET), conducted by NBEMS.
After the results, an all-India merit list of the qualified candidates is prepared and published.
Candidates who clear the required cutoff for the
NEET PG
exam should apply for online counselling.
During the choice filling and locking, candidates must choose IPGMER Kolkata as their preference. Then, results are declared and allotment letters are given to candidates.
Selected candidates must complete the document verification process and pay the fee to confirm admission.

Is IPGMER Kolkata government or private?
PG Hospital, also known as the Institute of Post-Graduate Medical Education and Research and SSKM Hospital, is a public medical college and hospital situated in Kolkata, India.

Yes, the Institute of Post-Graduate Medical Education and Research Kolkata is affiliated with The West Bengal University of Health Sciences, Kolkata and approved by the National Medical Commission.
